fullPassage: Creativity is the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on existing datasets, often identifying patterns and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack genuine originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges that we refine our skills, develop our unique perspectives, and push the boundaries of what is possible. If AI provides instant solutions, it can enhance this essential process of learning through trial and error, ultimately inhibiting the development of true creative talent.

questions.passage: Creativity ①<u>is</u> the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. AI algorithms are ②<u>trained</u> on existing datasets, often ③<u>identify</u> patterns and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for ④<u>generating</u> new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①~이다 ②훈련된 ③식별하다(→identifying) ④생성하는
det.analysis:
❌ ③ identify → identifying: 분사구문(주절의 부수적 행동)이므로 -ing 형태가 필요. often identifying patterns = 종종 패턴을 식별하면서
✅ ① is: 3인칭 단수 현재 정상
✅ ② trained: 수동태 과거분사 정상 (are trained on)
✅ ④ generating: 전치사 for 뒤 동명사 정상
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어가 같을 때 부가 설명. identifying = ~하면서

questions.passage: If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find ①<u>themselves</u> ②<u>trapping</u> in a cycle of imitation, ③<u>unable</u> to break free from the ④<u>constraints</u> of the AI's training data.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①그들 자신을 ②가두는(→trapped 갇힌) ③~할 수 없는 ④제약
det.analysis:
❌ ② trapping → trapped: find + 목적어 + 목적격보어 구문에서 목적어(themselves)와 보어의 관계가 수동이므로 과거분사 trapped가 맞음. '자신들이 갇힌 것을 발견하다'
✅ ① themselves: 재귀대명사 정상
✅ ③ unable: 형용사로 분사구문의 보어 정상
✅ ④ constraints: 복수 명사 정상
det.tip: find + O + p.p.: ~이 ~된 것을 발견하다. find themselves trapped = 자신들이 갇힌 것을 알게 되다

questions.passage: The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges ①<u>which</u> we ②<u>refine</u> our skills, ③<u>develop</u> our unique perspectives, and push the boundaries of ④<u>what</u> is possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①~한(→that) ②연마하다 ③발전시키다 ④~한 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① which → that: 'It is ~ that ...'는 강조 구문. 관계대명사 which가 아닌 that을 써야 함
✅ ② refine: 동사원형 정상 (주어 we)
✅ ③ develop: refine과 병렬 동사 정상
✅ ④ what: 관계대명사 what = the thing that, '가능한 것'
det.tip: It is ~ that 강조 구문: It is through these challenges THAT we refine. which 사용 불가

questions.passage: While this can be ①<u>useful</u> for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that ②<u>lack</u> genuine originality. If artists rely too heavily on AI, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation, unable to ③<u>breaking</u> free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease ④<u>with which</u> AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①유용한 ②부족하다 ③~을 벗어나다(→break) ④~하는
det.analysis:
❌ ③ breaking → break: 'unable to + 동사원형' 구조. to부정사 뒤에는 원형이 와야 함
✅ ① useful: be동사(can be) 뒤 형용사 보어 정상
✅ ② lack: 관계대명사 that 뒤 동사, 선행사 works(복수)에 맞는 원형 정상
✅ ④ with which: 전치사+관계대명사 정상. the ease with which = ~하는 용이함
det.tip: unable to + 동사원형: unable to break(○) / unable to breaking(×)

"AI can lead to works that copy others rather than being original — these are called __________ works."

det.korean: AI는 독창적이기보다 다른 것을 모방하는 작품으로 이어질 수 있다 — 이런 작품을 __________ 작품이라 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ derivative: 원문 'derivative works that lack genuine originality'에서 직접 찾음
det.tip: derivative = 파생적인, 독창성이 없는. derivative works = 파생 작품

questions.passage: If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves _____ in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.
"Artists may become __________ in a cycle of imitation when they depend too much on AI."

det.korean: AI에 지나치게 의존하면 예술가들은 모방의 순환에 __________될 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ trapped: 원문 'find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation'에서 직접 찾음
det.tip: trapped = 갇힌, 빠져나오지 못하는. be trapped in = ~에 갇히다

questions.passage: Creativity is the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness ①<u>to</u> experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool ②<u>for</u> creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, ③<u>involve</u> numerous failures. It is through these challenges ④<u>that</u> we refine our skills.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①~하기 위해 ②~를 위한 ③포함하다(→involving) ④~한
det.analysis:
❌ ③ involve → involving: 분사구문이므로 -ing 필요. 앞 문장의 부가 설명
✅ ① to: willingness to(~하려는 의지) 정상
✅ ② for: a tool for(~를 위한 도구) 전치사 정상
✅ ④ that: It is ~ that 강조구문 정상
det.tip: 분사구문 = V-ing. involving numerous failures = 수많은 실패를 수반하며

questions.passage: Creativity is the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on existing datasets, often identifying patterns and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack genuine originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges that we refine our skills, develop our unique perspectives, and push the boundaries of what is possible. If AI provides instant solutions, it can enhance this essential process of learning through trial and error, ultimately inhibiting the development of true creative talent.
questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI가 창의성에 미치는 부정적 영향
det.analysis:
✅ ① AI가 창의성과 독창성에 미치는 위험 — 글 전체가 AI 의존의 부정적 결과를 논함
❌ ② AI 알고리즘의 기술적 작동 원리 — 기술 원리 설명이 아닌 영향 논의
❌ ③ 예술가를 위한 AI 도구의 장점 — 장점이 아닌 위험/한계 중심
❌ ④ 확산적 사고의 역사적 발전 — 역사적 내용 없음
det.tip: 주제 = 핵심 메시지. 'risk of limiting originality', 'trapped in imitation'이 반복

questions.stem: 윗글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI의 과도한 의존이 창의적 재능 발달을 방해할 수 있다
det.analysis:
✅ ④ AI에 대한 과도한 의존은 시행착오를 통한 학습을 방해하여 진정한 창의적 재능 발달을 억제할 수 있다 — ultimately inhibiting the development of true creative talent
❌ ① AI는 모든 창의적 작업에서 인간을 대체할 수 있다 — 대체 언급 없음
❌ ② 기술의 발전은 항상 예술의 질을 향상시킨다 — 항상은 극단적이며 원문은 부정적
❌ ③ 창의적 과정에서 실패는 불필요하다 — 실패가 필수적이라고 함
det.tip: 요지 = 글쓴이의 핵심 주장. 'inhibiting the development of true creative talent'

ch: AI에 대한 과도한 의존은 진정한 창의적 재능 발달을 억제할 수 있다.

det.korean: 창의적 과정은 수많은 실패와 __________을 수반한다.
det.analysis: ✅ setbacks: 원문 'involving numerous failures and setbacks'
